claims.content: The Customer wants to create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A new customer registers on JTVauctions.com and, as a result, has a free membership account.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The customer begins the registration process for a new JTVauctions.com membership account.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The customer has successfully registered and has a free JTVauctions.com membership account.
in_scope_actions: Customer creates a free JTVauctions.com membership account

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has access to a valid email address and phone number.
The Customer is a new customer who does not already have a JTVauctions.com account.
The use case is triggered when a new customer decides to register on JTVauctions.com by clicking the 'Register Now' link in the top navigation bar and accessing Registration Page 1.
The customer enters their First Name and Last Name into the designated text fields on Registration Page 1.
The customer enters their E-mail Address twice to verify it and creates a Member ID ('Handle') that must be unique in the database customer table.
The customer creates a password (8 to 12 characters) and verifies it by re-entering it.
The customer selects a payment method from the available options (PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Credit Card).
The customer checks the box to accept and agree to the Terms of Use.

The customer either clicks the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button to finish the short registration process immediately without providing additional optional information, or, instead, proceeds to Registration Page 2 to provide optional billing/shipping addresses, shipping preferences, and email preferences and completes the full registration process by clicking 'Finish Now' (or 'Save Changes'); when the full registration is completed via 'Save Changes', the system displays a pop-up message instructing the user to add the shop email to their safe senders list and enable cookies.

Upon completion of the registration process, the system triggers an automated transactional email with a Thank You message instructing the customer to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list.

Diverges from Step 6: After completing the short registration fields on Page 1, instead of clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' to finish the short registration, the customer proceeds to Registration Page 2, where they may optionally provide additional information such as billing/shipping addresses, shipping preferences, and email preferences, and then clicks the 'Finish Now' button to complete the full registration process immediately.

At step 2, if the entered E-mail Address already exists in the customer table, the system notifies the registrant that the email address is already in use and registration cannot proceed; the system asks the registrant if they need to reset the password for that account, and if the user indicates 'yes', the system generates an email with a temporary password.
At step 2, if the Member ID ('Handle') is not unique in the database customer table, the input is invalid and registration cannot proceed.
At step 3, if the password entered is outside the required 8-to-12 character range, the input is invalid and registration cannot proceed.

At step 6, if the customer attempts to finish the registration without checking/agreeing to the Terms of Use checkbox, the system prevents submission: the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button is grayed out until the checkbox is checked, and clicking the grayed-out 'Finish Now' button (the alternative full-registration path) shows a popup stating that the customer must read and agree to the Terms of Use before proceeding. A customer who does not agree to be bound by the Terms of Use cannot access or use the Website or submit an order or bid.

At step 6, when a new customer attempts to create the account, the system cross-references the Consumer Protection negative file; if there is a match, the registrant receives the message: 'We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393.' The system does not complete account creation for that registrant.

missing_aspects: Age eligibility restriction (EC-EF-017) has no corresponding main_flow validation step.
Cookie-disabled browser failure (EC-EF-014) has no corresponding main_flow validation step.
Evidence for the specific error message or UI behavior displayed when the handle is taken.

claims.content: After the registration process is completed (either via short or full registration), the system displays a 'Welcome Back!' message and presents the Sign In page with fields for Member ID/Email and Password.

The system sends an automated transactional email with a 'Thank You' message instructing the Customer to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list.

If the Customer completes the full registration path on Registration Page 2 via the 'Finish Now' button, all provided optional information (billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences) is saved to the Customer's account profile.

If registration is completed via the 'Save Changes' button, the system displays a pop-up instructing the Customer to add shop@jewelryTV.rsys1.com to their address book or safe senders list and to enable cookies in their browser.

inconsistency_hints: The Main Flow only models the short-registration path ending with the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button. It never branches to Registration Page 2 or includes the 'Finish Now'/'Save Changes' completion paths, so the postconditions about saving full-registration optional data and displaying the Save Changes pop-up are not reachable from the Main Flow.

The Trigger is limited to a 'new customer' clicking 'Register Now', but Preconditions only requires valid email and phone number. The Customer's status as a new/unregistered user is an independent external state that must already hold before this Trigger can validly start, and it is missing from Preconditions.

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
